text: Objectives The PhD program in Mechanical Engineering provides students with solid theory and the latest technological knowledge. The program has a practical orientation and aims to equip engineers with knowledge in modern experimental methods and research skills that allow them to meet the complexities of today’s challenges in the field of mechanical engineering. Students are expected to engage in high level scientific research, and to assume leadership role in their related fields. Duration Duration of program is between 3-4 years with course works in the first year, followed by a dissertation project. In a special case, duration of the program may be extended to 5 years with approval. Research Areas 1. Design and Manufacturing 2. Mechatronics and Automation 3. Fluid and Heat Transfer Credit Units Students need to successfully complete minimum 13 credits. Scholarships 1.The Shenzhen Universiade International Scholarship 2.HITSZ Scholarship
